# freshdesk_contact (Data Source)

Look up a single contact by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_contact" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the contact to look up.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the contact activated their portal account.
- `address` (String) Postal address.
- `company_id` (Number) ID of the company the contact belongs to.
- `contact_type` (String) Contact type reported by the API.
- `created_at` (String) When the contact was created (RFC 3339).
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values keyed by field name.
- `description` (String) Free-text note about the contact.
- `email` (String) Primary email address.
- `job_title` (String) Job title.
- `language` (String) Language code.
- `mobile` (String) Mobile number.
- `name` (String) Name of the contact.
- `other_emails` (Set of String) Additional email addresses.
- `phone` (String) Telephone number.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the contact.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone.
- `twitter_id` (String) Twitter handle.
- `unique_external_id` (String) Identifier in an external system.
- `updated_at` (String) When the contact was last changed (RFC 3339).
- `view_all_tickets` (Boolean) Whether the contact sees their company's tickets.
